title: Pure Sacred Beast
summary: The retrained Sacred Beast engine from Chaos Origins and Sacred Beasts Skyfall, paired with Illusion Gate and generic staples. Because the modern cards look for the "Sacred Beast" archetype name directly, the original Uria, Hamon, and Raviel are replaced by their Level 10 Sacred Beast retrains.

summary.title: Starters
points: Infinity of the Sacred Beasts - Raviel, Calamity of the Sacred Beasts - Hamon, and Inferno of the Sacred Beasts - Uria each reveal themselves in your hand to search a Sacred Beast monster, Spell, or Trap respectively, then discard 1 card.

Martyr of the Sacred Beasts places a Sacred Beast Field Spell or Continuous Spell/Trap face-up from the Deck when Normal Summoned, and Special Summons 2 more Martyrs from the Deck while you control another Sacred Beast monster.

Sacred Beasts Thunderclap places 2 more copies of itself from the Deck face-up on your field, then reveals a Level 10 Sacred Beast in your hand to place Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts in your Field Zone.
Sacred Beasts Released adds three different Sacred Beast monsters from the Deck and discards two.

summary.title: Opening: Martyr of the Sacred Beasts + Level 10 Sacred Beast
steps: Normal Summon Martyr of the Sacred Beasts to place Sacred Beasts Thunderclap face-up from the Deck; Thunderclap places 2 more copies of itself and places Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts in the Field Zone.

Activate Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts by sending the three Thunderclaps from your field to the GY to Special Summon Infinity Raviel or Calamity Hamon from your hand or GY, then draw 2 cards with Fallen Paradise.

Activate Martyr of the Sacred Beasts to Special Summon 2 more Martyrs from the Deck—either keeping them as Tributes for Infinity Raviel's opponent-turn board wipe or sending all three Martyrs with Fallen Paradise to summon a second Level 10 Sacred Beast.

summary.title: Sacred Beasts Skyfall & Illusion Gate
summary.text: Sacred Beasts Skyfall is a three-mode Quick-Play Spell searchable by Calamity Hamon: it can negate an opponent's effect chained to your Sacred Beast monster's effect, reveal a Level 10 Sacred Beast and discard a card to search Illusion Gate (which pays half your LP to destroy all monsters the opponent controls and steal one from their GY), or shuffle 3 Sacred Beast Traps from your GY into the Deck to destroy a card on the field.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Infinity of the Sacred Beasts - Raviel Tributes 2 monsters as a Quick Effect on the opponent's turn to destroy all monsters they control and gain 1000 ATK per monster destroyed.

Calamity of the Sacred Beasts - Hamon inflicts 1000 burn damage whenever monsters are sent to the opponent's GY, while Inferno of the Sacred Beasts - Uria destroys a Spell/Trap without allowing responses.
The Chaotic Phantasmal Sacred Beasts (summoned via Sacred Beasts Combined Assault in the GY) negates up to three monsters per turn and survives two destructions.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Abyss of the Sacred Beasts places 2 more copies of itself from the Deck face-up on your field, then sends all 3 copies to the GY as a Quick Effect to flip an opposing monster face-down—fueling Sacred Beasts Skyfall's 3-Trap shuffle to destroy a second card.
Summoner of the Sacred Beasts discards 1 card to Special Summon a Sacred Beast from the hand or GY, and banishes itself from the GY to summon another.

allow.Illusion Gate: Sacred Beasts Skyfall's second effect searches it; the page's lines use it.

main: Calamity of the Sacred Beasts - Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder
Reveals itself to search a Sacred Beast Spell, Skyfall included; burns whenever their monsters hit the GY.
Infinity of the Sacred Beasts - Raviel, Lord of Phantasms
Reveals itself to search a Sacred Beast monster; Tributes two to wipe their monsters.
Inferno of the Sacred Beasts - Uria, Lord of Searing Flames
Reveals itself to search a Sacred Beast Trap; destroys a Spell/Trap with no response.
Summoner of the Sacred Beasts
Discards to summon a Sacred Beast from the hand or GY, and again from the GY.
Martyr of the Sacred Beasts
Summoned: places a Sacred Beast Field Spell or Continuous card from the Deck; calls two more copies.
Sacred Beasts Released
Adds three different Sacred Beast monsters and discards two.
Sacred Beasts Thunderclap
Places two more copies, then Fallen Paradise from the Deck.
Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts
Field Spell: sends three cards of one type to summon a Sacred Beast from anywhere; draws two with a Level 10 out.
Sacred Beasts Skyfall
Newest support. Negates a response to a Sacred Beast effect, finds Illusion Gate, or recycles three Traps to destroy a card.
Illusion Gate
Once per Duel: wipes their monsters and steals one from their GY.
Abyss of the Sacred Beasts
Places two more copies; three of them flip a monster face-down. Fuel for Skyfall and Uria.
Sacred Beasts Combined Assault
Revives a Sacred Beast and destroys a card; from the GY, Fusion Summons the Chaotic Phantasmal Sacred Beasts.
extra: Three Level 10s: negates up to three monsters a turn and survives two destructions.
